effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
＜Collision＞ (During this Digimon's attack, all of your opponent's Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞, and must block if possible.)
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may unsuspend 1 Digimon. Then, you may suspend 1 Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Ver.5] trait Digimon suspend, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
